raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "start living in"
      role subject "Chinedu"
      role destination "Reșița"
      role time ?t1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "start living in"
      role subject "Silviu"
      role destination "Reșița"
      role time ?t2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  order ?t1 before ?t2
